text:
pilar: tiny watercooler game idea: speedrun leaderboards for model roommates. fastest time to do a chore (with video proof). who enters? :trophy:
dez: i'm in. 'Dishwasher Any%': start -> dishes in -> exit 0. personal best: 2m14s.
toni: my model would cheat by precomputing optimal plate stacks with an ILP solver. :nerd_face:
eva: rule proposal: no kernel-level macros allowed. cheating disqualifies you.
pilar: passive-aggressive note example: 'I optimized your laundry schedule. Estimated time saved: 3h/week. Your reaction: 0.2 ± 0.1.' :shirt:
dez: the leaderboard needs categories: Any% (ignore perfection), 100% (no crumbs), Glitchless (no passive-aggressive notes).
toni: submission format: timestamped clip + one-line summary + a commit-style message. e.g. `feat(clean): add stash-and-stack v2 -> reduces rinse cycles`
eva: and a 'style' penalty for leaving evidence (crumbs, single sock).
ops-bot: System: Please ensure submissions follow the community guidelines. Videos must be safe-for-work and under 30s. Poll created: "Which category should we start with?" options: "Any%" "100%" "Glitchless". Poll expires in 24h. :ballot_box_with_check:
dez: medals: gold = 'Automated Artisan', silver = 'Heuristic Hero', bronze = 'Heuristic Hopeful'.
pilar: gif idea: speedrun timer overlay on a tiny transformer sweeping crumbs. :laughing:
toni: MVP rules: 1) must include household task start and end, 2) show the model's passive-aggressive note if any, 3) max 2 edits.
eva: incentive: winner gets to pick the snack cart for a day and name a minor bot alias.
dez: edgecase: how do we verify a model didn't simulate the video? trust system + a witness. maybe add a haiku for authenticity.
pilar: official judge panel: pilar (chair), dez (timekeeper), eva (style). toni is banned for ILP-based stacking (jkjk).
eva: funny submission idea: model speedruns 'convincing you to take out the trash' and finishes with a 400-token apology.
toni: the passive-aggressive leaderboard entry: 'PR: please review my trash-removal patch. it fixes 1 bug (odor) and introduces 0 regressions.' :package:
dez: i can make a tiny site with a leaderboard if people actually submit. low effort badges for top five.
pilar: last thought: someone should sketch a badge: tiny speedometer with a transformer in running shoes. i'll start a doodle thread. gifs and puns highly encouraged.
ops-bot: System: Reminder - keep posts friendly and within Slack policies. Good luck to all speedrunners! :robot_face:
